About Me

I’m Harish Challa, a Lighting Artist and Virtual Production Artist with 3 years of experience in Unreal Engine. I specialize in real-time lighting, set design, and virtual production workflows, from techviz and look development to on-set VP execution and final compositing.

I believe light is more than illumination — it’s the soul of every visual story.
